cards: **V1 · Force-field error floor for coolant MD: an enlarged C10–C50 benchmark scored against measurement.** seed pick · compute tested: yes · plan expects: unsure · halted: cost record broken **Question.** Does one GPU-MD force field rank C10–C50 hydrocarbons and esters in the same order as measured viscosity and thermal conductivity? **What is known.** Messerly 2018 scored Green-Kubo viscosity of 14 normal and branched alkanes against reference data; largest set used. No prior work reports the force-field error distribution or rank correlation across dozens to hundreds of C10-C50 hydrocarbons and esters scored against measurement. **Hypothesis.** One TraPPE-UA Green-Kubo protocol reproduces the measured ranking of coolants because its viscosity error is a systematic bias, not a random floor. **Restructuring.** Each molecule's viscosity and thermal conductivity come from one Green-Kubo trajectory, ~50 million steps accumulated in order. None: every molecule is an independent run, so GPUs only run them side by side. **If compute is the lever.** The MD-vs-measurement rank correlation reaches at least 0.9 once 30+ molecules are scored, so rankings can be trusted. **If not.** The rank correlation plateaus below 0.75 even at 60 molecules, so the force-field error is a random floor. **Test.** Run one GPU Green-Kubo protocol for viscosity and thermal conductivity over 60 C10-C50 hydrocarbons and esters, score against measured values, and test whether the MD ranking correlation holds as molecules are added. *Compute axis.* Benchmark molecules scored (each one independent GPU-MD run): 8–60 molecules, 3 levels. Closest prior: 14 [s1]. **Check first.** Setup reproduces published n-hexadecane Green-Kubo thermal conductivity 0.14 W/(m·K) matching its experiment, before scoring other molecules. Tolerance: ±30% (0.098-0.182 W/(m·K)). **Would not show.** Shows ranking reliability for one force field and one temperature; not best force field, not novel-coolant discovery, not fluorinated coolants. *Cost.* Over budget: plans $7,653.60 against the $1,000 budget. Main guess: MD thermal conductivity at the anchor molecule [g], measured after $636.80 of spend; the budget is reached if it is 1.0× higher. 6 cost flags in the block. **Halted at cost record
